subject.title: fix(workboard): decomposed children no longer block aggregate parents

question: Should legacy decomposed Workboard cards be migrated automatically through the Workboard Doctor flow, or should the product intentionally require operators to discover and run a manual repair tool?
rationale: This choice determines the durable upgrade contract for persisted card relationships and the permanent public Workboard API surface; it cannot be settled safely by tests alone.

options.title: Use a Doctor migration
options.body: Detect only proven legacy decomposition links, provide dry-run and apply behavior through the plugin's Doctor contract, and verify the repaired cards can proceed.

options.title: Keep manual repair
options.body: Retain the explicit repair tool, but document that existing cards may remain blocked until an operator invokes it and accept that upgrade burden.

recommendation.title: Use a Doctor migration
recommendation.body: Detect only proven legacy decomposition links, provide dry-run and apply behavior through the plugin's Doctor contract, and verify the repaired cards can proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the only supplied implementation and can provide the immediate design context, although current-main ownership still needs confirmation from a maintainer-area history pass.
